name: ESOI applied to AI behaviour
vision_statement: An AI agent acts by the evolvable-structure principles in its own work, and a calibrated judge shows whether it does.
opportunity: AI agents are how structure is applied at scale, and whether an agent holds back, keeps a qualifier and builds through solution interfaces is itself measurable and improvable. Behaviour cases, the ways of giving an agent the principles and a calibrated judge are a creative space beyond the solution of guiding agents by standing instructions, and meaningful enough to deserve focused attention, further specification and iteration.
